match.userMessage: Find out which of these companies run a small support team that still answers customer email by hand.

response.content: {"fields":[{"name":"support_channels","displayName":"Support Channels","description":"Channels the company offers for customer support (email, chat, phone, help centre, community forum).","type":"array","examples":["email","live chat","help centre"],"strategy":"search"},{"name":"support_email_published","displayName":"Support Email Published","description":"Whether the company publishes a support email address customers write to directly.","type":"boolean","examples":["true","false"],"strategy":"search"},{"name":"help_desk_tool","displayName":"Help Desk Tool","description":"The help desk or ticketing product the support team uses, if any is visible.","type":"string","examples":["none detected","shared mailbox"],"strategy":"agent"},{"name":"support_team_size","displayName":"Support Team Size","description":"Approximate number of people working in customer support.","type":"number","examples":["2","6"],"strategy":"agent"},{"name":"open_support_roles","displayName":"Open Support Roles","description":"Customer support job openings currently advertised.","type":"array","examples":["Customer Support Specialist"],"strategy":"search"}],"groups":[{"id":"support-setup","label":"How support is delivered","fieldNames":["support_channels","support_email_published","help_desk_tool"],"strategy":"search","queries":["{company} contact support email","site:{domain} help OR support OR contact","{company} help centre powered by"],"preferredSources":["the company website contact and help pages","help centre footers that name the ticketing product"],"instructions":"Good evidence is a support page on the company domain or a help centre linked from it.
